question: A number, when decreased by 7%, gives 3720. The number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the original number be 100%.

After a 7% decrease, the number becomes 100% − 7% = 93%.

Given that 93% of the number = 3720.

1% of the number = 3720 ÷ 93 = 40.

Original Number (100%) = 40 × 100 = 4000.

**∴ The correct answer is 4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A number when decreased by 7% gives 3720.

**Formula Used:**

Decreased Value = Original Value × (1 − Rate ÷ 100)

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Original Number (100%) = ?
 
 
 Decreased Value (93%)
 
 
 −7%

 3720
 
 1% = 3720 ÷ 93 = 40 → 100% = 4000

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the original number be x.

⇒ x − (7% of x) = 3720

⇒ x × (1 − 0.07) = 3720

⇒ 0.93x = 3720

⇒ x = 3720 ÷ 0.93

⇒ x = 372000 ÷ 93

⇒ x = 4000

**∴ The correct answer is 4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

Percentage change indicates the degree of change over time, calculated as: % Change = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100.

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is subjected to successive percentage changes a% and b%, the net percentage change is given by the formula: (a + b + ab ÷ 100)%.

Base Change Method

If A is x% more than B, then B is [x ÷ (100 + x)] × 100% less than A. Similarly, if A is x% less than B, then B is [x ÷ (100 − x)] × 100% more than A.
